lines.zh: 我沿着橡树根跑，尾巴翘得老高。
lines.en: I run along the oak roots, tail high.

lines.zh: 草叶比我高，我跳着走。
lines.en: The grass is taller than me; I hop through.

lines.zh: 四只爪子落地很轻，听不见。
lines.en: Four paws land lightly; you hear nothing.

lines.zh: 我跑两步，停一下，再跑。
lines.en: I run two steps, pause, then run again.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，我就换了方向。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and I change direction.

lines.zh: 平原上的风把我的毛吹乱。
lines.en: The plains wind ruffles my fur.

lines.zh: 我踩着倒下的树干过沟。
lines.en: I cross the ditch on a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 前面有棵小树，我窜上去。
lines.en: A small tree ahead — I dart up it.

lines.zh: 我抱着一个核桃，跑得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: Carrying a walnut, I run a crooked line.

lines.zh: 草籽粘了我一身，我甩不掉。
lines.en: Grass seeds cling to me and won't shake off.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，从草缝里钻过去。
lines.en: I skirt the stone and slip between grass stems.

lines.zh: 我跑得急，尾巴在后面飘。
lines.en: I run fast, my tail streaming behind.

lines.zh: 我坐在树杈上，尾巴卷到脚边。
lines.en: I sit on a branch with my tail curled at my feet.

lines.zh: 两只前爪捧着核桃，慢慢啃。
lines.en: I hold a walnut in my paws and gnaw slowly.

lines.zh: 我把脸埋进尾巴里，暖得很。
lines.en: I bury my face in my tail; it's warm.

lines.zh: 远处有只鹰，我贴着树皮不动。
lines.en: A hawk is out there; I press flat to the bark.

lines.zh: 我用后爪挠了挠耳朵后面。
lines.en: I scratch behind my ear with a hind paw.

lines.zh: 太阳穿过叶子，落在我背上。
lines.en: Sun through the leaves lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我数着树上的果子，一颗两颗。
lines.en: I count the nuts on the tree: one, two.

lines.zh: 风一吹，整棵树都在动。
lines.en: The wind blows and the whole tree sways.

lines.zh: 我张大嘴打哈欠，露出小门牙。
lines.en: I yawn and show my tiny teeth.

lines.zh: 有片叶子掉了，我盯着它落下去。
lines.en: A leaf falls, and I watch it all the way down.

lines.zh: 我把核桃换个地方藏，藏了三回。
lines.en: I hide the walnut somewhere new — three times.

lines.zh: 树下有脚印，我探头去看。
lines.en: There are prints below; I lean out to look.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖尾巴，灰尘散开。
lines.en: I shake my tail and dust scatters.

lines.zh: 这片平原很安静，只有虫叫。
lines.en: This plain is quiet but for the insects.

lines.zh: 我趴在枝上，看蚂蚁排队。
lines.en: I lie on a branch, watching ants line up.

lines.zh: 我咬开一颗核桃，壳很脆。
lines.en: I crack a walnut. The shell is brittle.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴盖在背上，挡风。
lines.en: I lay my tail over my back against the wind.

lines.zh: 我听见树下有东西在翻土。
lines.en: I hear something turning soil below.

lines.zh: 你手里是核桃吗？我闻到味了。
lines.en: Is that a walnut? I smell it.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，前爪搭在树干上。
lines.en: I tilt my head, forepaws on the trunk.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我先看看你。
lines.en: Stand still; let me look at you first.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴比我的身子还大。
lines.en: My tail is bigger than my body.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就敢下树。
lines.en: If you crouch, I'll dare come down.

lines.zh: 你身上有树皮和草的味道。
lines.en: You smell of bark and grass.

lines.zh: 你看我我看你，谁都没动。
lines.en: We size each other up; neither moves.

lines.zh: 你伸手太快，我缩回去了。
lines.en: You reach too fast; I duck back in.

lines.zh: 我认识你的帽子，昨天见过。
lines.en: I know that hat; I saw it yesterday.

lines.zh: 你笑的时候，牙比我少。
lines.en: Your smile shows fewer teeth than mine do.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，鼓鼓的。
lines.en: I stare at your pocket; it's bulging.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我就往上爬一格。
lines.en: Each step you take, I climb one branch higher.

lines.zh: 我叫得很尖，尾巴炸开了。
lines.en: I squeal sharply and my tail puffs out.

lines.zh: 这一下让我翻了半个跟头。
lines.en: That blow turns me half a somersault.

lines.zh: 我缩到树根下面，抖个不停。
lines.en: I duck under the roots and keep trembling.

lines.zh: 毛掉了一撮，很显眼。
lines.en: A tuft of fur is gone; it shows.

lines.zh: 我疼得直跳，还不敢叫太响。
lines.en: I hop in pain but dare not cry loudly.

lines.zh: 前爪有点麻，抓不住树皮了。
lines.en: My forepaw is numb; I can't grip bark.

lines.zh: 我飞快地爬上树，躲进叶子。
lines.en: I scramble up the tree and hide in the leaves.

lines.zh: 血没流，可皮破了一块。
lines.en: No blood, but the skin is broken.

lines.zh: 我回头瞪了你一眼，才跑。
lines.en: I glare back at you once before I run.

lines.zh: 我抱着尾巴，蹲在枝上喘气。
lines.en: I hug my tail and pant on the branch.

lines.zh: 核桃！我闻到它的壳了。
lines.en: Walnut! I can smell the shell.

lines.zh: 你把核桃放在手心，我犹豫。
lines.en: You set the walnut on your palm; I hesitate.

lines.zh: 我先绕着树跑一圈，再回来。
lines.en: I run one lap around the tree, then come back.

lines.zh: 这颗核桃的壳很薄，我听得出来。
lines.en: This walnut's shell is thin; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我伸出前爪，又收了回去。
lines.en: I reach out a forepaw, then pull it back.

lines.zh: 你退后，我就下来拿。
lines.en: Back away and I'll come down for it.

lines.zh: 蜜脾的甜味让我尾巴都竖了。
lines.en: The sweetness of honeycomb lifts my tail straight up.

lines.zh: 我想把核桃藏起来，先藏哪好？
lines.en: I want to hide the walnut — where first?

lines.zh: 我试探着往前挪，爪子很轻。
lines.en: I inch forward, paws very light.

lines.zh: 东西到手，我立刻跑回树上。
lines.en: Once I have it, I bolt back up the tree.

lines.zh: 撞到我的尾巴，像撞一团毛。
lines.en: Bumping my tail is like bumping a ball of fur.

lines.zh: 我太矮，你差点踩到我。
lines.en: I'm low; you nearly stepped on me.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边溜过去，很快。
lines.en: I slip past your feet, quick as that.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我落地没看方向。
lines.en: Sorry — I landed without checking where.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，草被踩倒一片。
lines.en: We collide and flatten a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 我退到树后，只露出一只眼。
lines.en: I retreat behind the tree, one eye showing.

lines.zh: 你踢起的土落了我一身。
lines.en: Dirt you kicked up lands all over me.

lines.zh: 我又撞了一下，这次是故意的。
lines.en: I bump you again — on purpose this time.

lines.zh: 我绕着你跑了一圈，才停下。
lines.en: I circle you once before stopping.

lines.zh: 这么近，我能看清你的鞋带。
lines.en: This close, I can see your shoelaces.

lines.zh: 我把藏得最好的核桃让给她。
lines.en: I give her the walnut I hid best.

lines.zh: 我们的尾巴缠在一起，毛都乱了。
lines.en: Our tails tangle and the fur goes messy.

lines.zh: 她啃核桃，我在旁边看着。
lines.en: She gnaws the walnut; I watch beside her.

lines.zh: 我追着她绕树跑了三圈。
lines.en: I chase her three times around the tree.

lines.zh: 蜜脾一人一半，她吃得很快。
lines.en: Half a honeycomb each; she finishes fast.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰她的耳朵。
lines.en: My nose brushes softly against her ear.

lines.zh: 我们并排蹲在树杈上，尾巴垂着。
lines.en: We perch side by side, tails hanging down.

lines.zh: 她叫一声，我就跟一声。
lines.en: She chatters once, and I answer.

lines.zh: 以后这棵树，我们俩一起守。
lines.en: From now on, we guard this tree together.

lines.zh: 等小松鼠会跑了，我教它藏果子。
lines.en: When the pups can run, I'll teach them to cache nuts.

lines.zh: 我叼起树苗，跑向空地。
lines.en: I take the sapling and run for open ground.

lines.zh: 这个位置有阳光，树苗能活。
lines.en: This spot gets sun; the sapling will live.

lines.zh: 我用前爪刨了个小坑。
lines.en: I dig a small hole with my forepaws.

lines.zh: 树苗放进去，我把土推回来。
lines.en: The sapling goes in and I push the soil back.

lines.zh: 我又捡了一根，藏到树根下。
lines.en: I pick up another and hide it under the roots.

lines.zh: 这根树苗太细，我换一根。
lines.en: This sapling is too thin; I'll take another.

lines.zh: 我把树苗含在嘴里，跑得慢。
lines.en: Carrying the sapling in my mouth slows me down.

lines.zh: 种好了，我退后看看直不直。
lines.en: Planted — I step back to check it stands straight.

lines.zh: 这片空地以后会长成一片林子。
lines.en: This clearing will grow into a wood someday.

lines.zh: 我捡东西从不空手回去。
lines.en: I never go back empty-pawed.

lines.zh: 树下有个东西，圆圆的。
lines.en: Something round lies under the tree.

lines.zh: 草丛里闪了一下，是核桃壳。
lines.en: A glint in the grass — a walnut shell.

lines.zh: 有棵小树苗倒在路边。
lines.en: A sapling has fallen by the path.

lines.zh: 我闻到蜜脾的味道了。
lines.en: I've caught the smell of honeycomb.

lines.zh: 那只鸟在藏东西，我记住了。
lines.en: That bird is caching something; I've noted where.

lines.zh: 风把一个轻东西吹到我脚边。
lines.en: The wind blows something light to my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，耳朵先立起来。
lines.en: I raise my head; my ears stand up first.

lines.zh: 那边有影子在动，很小。
lines.en: A shadow moves over there, very small.

lines.zh: 这块地空着，正适合种树。
lines.en: This ground is bare — good for planting.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个东西，尾巴不动。
lines.en: I stare at it and my tail goes still.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，一点一点挪过去。
lines.en: I lower myself and edge over bit by bit.

lines.zh: 它还没发现我，我绕到树后。
lines.en: It hasn't seen me; I slip behind the tree.

lines.zh: 草太响，我改走树根那边。
lines.en: The grass is loud; I take the tree roots instead.

lines.zh: 近了，我能看清它的壳纹。
lines.en: Close now — I can see the lines on its shell.

lines.zh: 我停下来，等它自己转过去。
lines.en: I stop and wait for it to turn away.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴翘太高，得放低。
lines.en: My tail is too high; I need to lower it.

lines.zh: 一步，再一步，别踩到枯叶。
lines.en: One step, another — don't crunch the dry leaves.

lines.zh: 它动了，我也停住不动。
lines.en: It moves; I freeze in place.

lines.zh: 我爬到低枝上，从上面看。
lines.en: I climb a low branch to look down at it.

lines.zh: 就差一尺，我数到三再动。
lines.en: One foot away; I count to three, then move.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，用前爪抓。
lines.en: I leap in and rake with my forepaws.

lines.zh: 小牙也能咬得很深。
lines.en: These small teeth can bite deep.

lines.zh: 我跳到它背上，尾巴扫它眼睛。
lines.en: I jump on its back and sweep my tail at its eyes.

lines.zh: 打不过我就跑，这不丢人。
lines.en: If I'm losing, I run; no shame in that.

lines.zh: 我咬住就甩头，像撕树皮。
lines.en: I bite and twist, like tearing bark.

lines.zh: 它块头比我大，我照样敢冲。
lines.en: It's bigger than me, and I'm not afraid.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下去，砸它一脚。
lines.en: I drop from above and kick down on it.

lines.zh: 打完我就窜回树上。
lines.en: When it's done, I dart back up the tree.

lines.zh: 这一爪只抓到它的毛。
lines.en: This swipe only catches its fur.

lines.zh: 我尖叫着冲过去，气势很足。
lines.en: I screech and charge — plenty of attitude.

lines.zh: 我在草丛里睁眼，露水很凉。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the grass; the dew is cold.

lines.zh: 平原很宽，草一直铺到天边。
lines.en: The plain is wide; grass runs to the horizon.

lines.zh: 第一件事是找棵树爬上去。
lines.en: First thing: find a tree and climb it.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经翘起来了。
lines.en: My tail is already up.

lines.zh: 地上有个核桃，我记住了位置。
lines.en: There's a walnut on the ground; I note the spot.

lines.zh: 风里有草和土的味道。
lines.en: The wind smells of grass and soil.

lines.zh: 我试着跑了两步，腿很轻。
lines.en: I try two steps; my legs feel light.

lines.zh: 远处有只松鼠在叫，我回了一声。
lines.en: A squirrel calls far off; I answer.

lines.zh: 这里树不多，正好够我住。
lines.en: Not many trees here — enough for me.

lines.zh: 我把第一颗果子埋进土里。
lines.en: I bury my first nut in the soil.

lines.zh: 草尖比我的耳朵还高。
lines.en: The grass tips stand taller than my ears.

lines.zh: 太阳升起来，我该活动了。
lines.en: The sun is up; time for me to move.

lines.zh: 火苗把我的毛燎焦了一片。
lines.en: The flames singe a patch of my fur.

lines.zh: 树枝断了，我一路摔下去。
lines.en: The branch snaps and I tumble all the way down.

lines.zh: 水进了鼻子，我扑腾着往上游。
lines.en: Water up my nose; I thrash toward the surface.

lines.zh: 轰的一声，我被气浪掀起来。
lines.en: A blast throws me up into the air.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的耳朵，钉在树干上。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my ear and pins into the trunk.

lines.zh: 紫色的雾让我头晕，尾巴垂了。
lines.en: Violet mist makes my head swim; my tail droops.

lines.zh: 我藏的核桃都忘了在哪。
lines.en: I've forgotten where I hid all my walnuts.

lines.zh: 雷落在树上，整棵树都白了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and the whole trunk goes white.

lines.zh: 脚下没有树，也没有草。
lines.en: No tree below me, and no grass.
